parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue with PositionField by modifying the field retrieval logic in _check_list_display_item. It removes the hasattr check and restructures the exception handling to ensure correct behavior.

issues.description: The patch introduces some changes in the logic flow and exception handling, which might slightly reduce readability for future maintainers.
